events.title: Guy Whittingham , whose 42 Division One goals weren't quite enough to get 포츠머스 promoted to the Premier League last season, is transferred to 애스턴 빌라 for £1.2million. In Division Three , 37-year-old Keith Alexander becomes the first black manager of a Football League club when he takes over at 링컨 시티 .

John Smith , leader of the Labour Party , opens 밀월's New Den , a 20,000-seat stadium, which sees its first action in a friendly with 스포르팅 that ends in a 2–1 win for the Lisbon club. The stadium was first planned in 1990 in the wake of the Taylor Report and was initially going to have a capacity of 25,000, but these plans were downsized as 밀월 could not meet the cost.

Frank Clark is named as manager of 노팅엄 포리스트, replacing 브라이언 클러프 , who retired earlier in the summer after 18 years at the helm. His first task is to guide Forest back into the Premier League after last season's relegation. On the same day, 입스위치 타운 manager John Lyall announces that he will become the club's director of football, and that Mick McGiven will take over as first-team manager. 맨체스터 유나이티드 win the FA Charity Shield on penalties after a 1–1 draw with 아스널 .
Ajax wins the Dutch Super Cup , the annual opening of the new season in the Eredivisie , by a 4–0 win over 페예노르트 .
첼시 buy midfielder Gavin Peacock from 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 for £1.2million, while 에버턴's longest-serving player Kevin Ratcliffe leaves Goodison Park after 15 years and joins 카디프 시티 on a free transfer.

On the opening day of the Premier League season, 코번트리 시티 pull off a major surprise by beating 아스널 3–0 in the first game at the new all-seater Highbury , with Micky Quinn scoring all three goals. 스윈던 타운 's first top division game ends in a 3–1 defeat at 셰필드 유나이티드. Last season's runners-up 애스턴 빌라 head the table with a 4–1 win over QPR . 입스위치 타운 beat 올덤 애슬레틱 3–0 at Boundary Park . The Division One campaign kicks off with a 5–0 win for 더비 카운티 over 선덜랜드 at the Baseball Ground . 미들즈브러 begin their quest for an immediate return to the Premier League with a 3–2 win at 노츠 카운티 . 크리스털 팰리스 begin their comeback trail with a goalless draw at home to 트랜미어 로버스 .

맨체스터 유나이티드's defence of the Premier League title begins with a 2–0 away win over 노리치 시티 , last season's third placed side. 노팅엄 포리스트 begin their Division One promotion push with a 1–1 draw at 사우스엔드 유나이티드 .
셰필드 웬즈데이 pay a club record fee £2.7million for 퀸스 파크 레인저스 midfielder Andy Sinton .

The second round of Premier League fixtures include a 3–0 home win for 맨체스터 유나이티드 over 셰필드 유나이티드, in which record signing Roy Keane scores his first two goals from the club. 노리치 시티 win 3–2 over 블랙번 로버스 at Ewood Park , 10 months after their found themselves on the receiving end of a 7–1 defeat there. 코번트리 시티 beat 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 2–1 at home, and QPR find themselves on the receiving end of a second successive comprehensive defeat, this time losing 3–1 at home to 리버풀 .
Tony Barton , who managed 애스턴 빌라 to European Cup glory in 1982, dies of a heart attack aged 56.

맨체스터 유나이티드 are held to a 1–1 home draw with newly promoted 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, allowing 에버턴 (who beat 셰필드 유나이티드 4–2, with Tony Cottee scoring a hat-trick) to go top of the Premier League after three games. 입스위치 타운 go second with a 1–0 home win over 첼시 . 노리치 시티 manage an impressive 4–0 win over Leeds at Elland Road . The Division One fixtures include a 5–3 home win for 노팅엄 포리스트 over 그림즈비 타운 , 선덜랜드's 4–0 win over 찰턴 애슬레틱 at Roker Park , and a 3–0 win over 더비 카운티 for 미들즈브러 at Ayresome Park .

리버풀 go top of the league for the first time since early 1991 with a 5–0 away win over 스윈던 타운. 사우스엔드 유나이티드 , who were contenders for place in the new Premier League two seasons ago, give their promotion dreams for this season a boost with a 4–1 win at 밀월 in Division One in one of the first games staged at 밀월's new stadium. A Midlands derby at St Andrew's sees 버밍엄 시티 and 울버햄프턴 원더러스 draw 2-2.
Lee Sharpe scores twice as 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat last season's runners-up 애스턴 빌라 2–1 at Villa Park , allowing United to go top of the Premier League – they will not be headed all season.

아스널 beat 리즈 유나이티드 2–1 at Highbury. 블랙번 로버스 beat 맨체스터 시티 2–0 at Maine Road . A thrilling game at Boundary Park sees Oldham and Coventry battle out a 3–3 draw. Dave Bassett 's 셰필드 유나이티드 beat his old club 윔블던 2–1 at Bramall Lane . 미들즈브러 remain top of Division One with a 4–1 win at 반즐리 .
스윈던 타운's dismal Premier League debut continues as they are crushed 5–1 at 사우샘프턴 .
피터 리드 is sacked by 맨체스터 시티 , who have lost three of their four opening FA Premier League games.
Brian Horton leaves 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 to become the new manager of 맨체스터 시티. He takes charge of his second game later in the day, as the Blues draw 1–1 at home to 코번트리 시티 in the Premier League.

The Premier League action includes a 2–0 home win over 아스널 over 에버턴, a 3–1 win at 사우샘프턴 for 맨체스터 유나이티드 and a 4–0 away win for QPR over their London rivals 웨스트햄 유나이티드. 크리스털 팰리스 boost their bid for an immediate return to the Premier League by beating 포츠머스 5–1. Last season's beaten playoff finalists 레스터 시티 beat 밀월 4–0 at Filbert Street .
Alan Shearer scores his first goal for 블랙번 로버스 since returning from injury in a 1–1 draw at his hometown club 뉴캐슬 유나이티드.

The first month of the league season ends with defending champions 맨체스터 유나이티드 top of the Premier League with 리버풀, 아스널, 노리치 시티 and 입스위치 타운 completing the top five. Meanwhile, 스윈던 타운 have gained just one point from their first-ever five top division games, and prop up the table. Completing the bottom three are 맨체스터 시티 and 셰필드 웬즈데이, who had been largely expected to compete near the top of the table this season. The first month of the Division One campaign has seen 미들즈브러 and 찰턴 애슬레틱 take a joint lead at the top of the table with 12 points. 노팅엄 포리스트, 울버햄프턴 원더러스 , 사우스엔드 유나이티드 and 크리스털 팰리스 occupy the playoff places.
